title: SaaS project hierarchy (Linear/Jira-style): org -> team -> project -> issue -> comment, guests and shared projects
issue: Every table's policy re-derives access through EXISTS chains (comments -> issues -> projects -> team_members/org_admins/shares/guests). Policy subqueries are never planned as joins, so a query joining comments, issues and projects runs the membership lookups per table and per row; the standard fixes (security definer array helper, denormalised project_id) move cost to writes.
symptom: Measured at 50k issues: nested-EXISTS naive_rls is 1-5x the baseline (worst on joins for the broad subject); best_practice_rls is on par for narrow subjects but ~80x slower than the baseline on the org_admin 'my_open' page (ORDER BY updated_at LIMIT) and probes issues per comment (comment_search 41 ms vs 0.4 ms once project_id is denormalised onto comments).

scale.meaning: number of issues; 110 projects (22 teams x 5 projects, 2 orgs), 2 comments per issue, ~1.3 issue_labels per issue, scale/200 users (min 50) with 2 team memberships each. 10x = 500k issues, 1M comments, ~670k issue_labels, 2.5k users; OpenFGA tuples stay at memberships and shares (~1k at default, ~10k at 10x), never per issue.
